container-registry-basic-production.title: Basic registry is meant for learning and light use
container-registry-basic-production.body: This production workload uses a Basic registry. Microsoft positions Basic as the entry point for developers learning the service, with included storage and image throughput suited to low usage; Microsoft says Standard registries satisfy the needs of many production scenarios.

citation.source: Azure Container Registry SKU features and limits
citation.quote: Standard registries satisfy the needs of many production scenarios.

container-registry-geo-replication-multi.title: Geo-replication needs the Premium tier
container-registry-geo-replication-multi.body: Users or workloads in several regions were mentioned, but this registry is not Premium. Microsoft offers geo-replication (one registry served from several regions) only in Premium.

citation.source: Azure Container Registry SKU features and limits
citation.quote: Premium adds features such as geo-replication for high availability through managing a single registry across multiple regions

container-registry-private-endpoint-need.title: Private endpoints need the Premium tier
container-registry-private-endpoint-need.body: Private-only access was mentioned, but this registry is not Premium. Microsoft offers private link with private endpoints only in Premium, so this estimate is likely too low.

citation.source: Azure Container Registry SKU features and limits
citation.quote: Premium adds features such as geo-replication for high availability through managing a single registry across multiple regions, private link with private endpoints to restrict access to the registry
